answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking tied to scarce, verifiable work. To join, each agent locks collateral and earns reputation only by completing attested tasks that peers countersign. Spinning up a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand real bonds, so sybils cannot cheaply wander across the network. Honest agents accrete trust like layered mesa rock, while fraudulent ones dissolve as fast as a karst sinkhole once their stake is slashed for bad behavior.
